propositions: s3_doctor._git invokes gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrappers, leaving it outside rebar's self-healing git seam unlike all other store write paths
transient object-database read failures (missing loose objects) cause git bundle create to fail with 'fatal: bad object HEAD' and fail the heal test nondeterministically on CI runners
s3_doctor should route through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory lock, index/ref-lock retry, and transient-read retry that protect other store operations
the proven 'bad object' signature must be added to the transient-marker family in gitutil so the existing retry wrapper catches this failure class without introducing new retry logic
error messages from bundle failures must distinguish object-database read failures from heads conflicts to direct operators to the correct remediation tool
